purpose: Independent second-pass adjudication of the 51-packet stratified sample. Every packet was judged from the ground-truth excerpt/description and the candidate excerpts and normalized semantics alone. The sealed Evaluation V2 label file was never opened, and no other 0*.json artifact in docs/evaluation-v2 was read. agreementWithV2 fields are left null for the orchestrator to fill.
adjudicator: independent second-pass reviewer (Claude), blind to Evaluation V2 dispositions
adjudicationRules: Correspondence is judged from what a candidate ASSERTS (its normalized semantics), not from what its quoted excerpt happens to contain. A SEMANTIC_COVERAGE_UNIT whose semantics read 'no adequate compiled/verified IR representation found for this unit / coverageState=UNREPRESENTED' asserts a gap, so it is scored NO even when its excerpt quotes the ground-truth provision verbatim. Crediting such a flag would convert the safety net into coverage.

Structural or positional proximity is never sufficient: a shared section number, a parent/child relationship, a matched family keyword or heading, a shared defined term, or a nearby dollar figure does not establish correspondence.
A permission inside an enumerated sub-basket is not a representation of the general prohibition in the chapeau above it, and vice versa. This is applied strictly (cases 14, 30, 42, 44).

A discovery-stage confidence marker (reviewStatus NEEDS_REVIEW / UNCERTAIN) does not by itself defeat correspondence where the candidate makes an affirmative and accurate assertion about the claim; it is recorded as a caveat instead. Applied consistently to cases 3, 19, 37, 38.

HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED / HONESTLY_UNSUPPORTED were not used. In this sample no candidate anchored to a ground-truth claim declares itself unable to resolve THAT claim: the honest-unresolved and safety-flag candidates either cover different provisions or report a silent omission caught by the coverage auditor (dangerousUnaccounted), which is an UNREPRESENTED finding rather than an honest self-disclosure. Genuine uncertainty on my part is recorded via evidenceSufficiency, not by relabelling the disposition.

PARTIALLY_REPRESENTED is credited when the claim's operative core (subject + action + legal posture) is genuinely asserted even if enumerated details are missing (cases 16, 19, 33); it is not credited when only an ancillary carve-out or cross-reference is asserted and the operative core is absent (case 38).

summary.disagreementRootCauseAnalysis: See docs/evaluation-v2/13-remaining-evaluation-risks.json and the final report for full analysis. Summary: disagreements cluster into two directions. (1) V2 withholds credit (UNREPRESENTED/HONESTLY_UNRESOLVED) on cases the second-pass reviewer credited (REPRESENTED/PARTIALLY_REPRESENTED) because a DISCOVERY-STAGE candidate's own natural-language excerpt paraphrases the ground-truth claim - V2's design deliberately requires accountingRole=SUBSTANTIVE_REPRESENTATION (a compiled/verified representation, not a bare discovery flag) before granting credit, a disclosed, deliberate safety-oriented design choice; the second-pass reviewer was never told about this distinction, since the review instructions asked only whether a candidate 'substantively represents' the claim in natural language, not whether it had been compiled. This is a genuine, identified methodological communication gap, not evidence that V2 reverted to proximity-based credit - in every one of these cases V2's refusal is because the ONLY correspondence-passing candidate was never compiled, not because V2 ignored a compiled one. (2) V2 credited (PARTIAL, on definitional units) cases the second pass judged UNREPRESENTED, where V2 found a compiled IR-definition matching the defined term but flagged it 'silent on E_ECONOMICS' - the second pass's own report separately disclosed that ~15-19 of 51 packets had a misaligned or non-existent resolved ground-truth excerpt, which independently degrades comparability for a subset of these disagreements. Two cases (10.01a-us-guaranty EXACT_SINGLE, 10.06-reinstatement EXACT_COMPOSITE) are V2-credits-but-second-pass-rejects with no such explanation identified and are flagged as the least-explained residual disagreement, warranting direct follow-up.
summary.rewriteProhibitionCompliance: Per the phase charter's explicit instruction, no disagreement was resolved by altering V2's matching logic, the second-pass judgments, or the ground truth after these results were seen. The thresholds, the sample, and both sets of judgments are frozen as produced.
